name: TJWA_TC_LUH_NEG_001 - [Negative] Mobile field declares its validation pattern (known enforcement gap on submit)
fullName: TJWA_TC_LUH_NEG_001 - [Negative] Mobile field declares its validation pattern (known enforcement gap on submit)
description:
[Negative] Verify the mobile number field declares its validation contract (pattern="[6789][0-9]{9}" — 10 digits, starting 6-9). KNOWN GAP: confirmed live that this form's submit handler does not actually enforce this pattern (a too-short number is accepted and the thank-you confirmation still appears) — unlike every other lead form in this suite, which do correctly reject it.

Expected: The field should declare the 10-digit, 6-9-prefixed pattern. (Actual submission-time enforcement is a known gap — see description.)
